plan: hard thinking: architecture, design, comparing options and trade-offs
understanding existing code: what it does, why it behaves this way, where something is
execute: small, quick edits: typos, renames, one-line fixes, config values
larger work: new features, refactors, changes across several files
review: correctness: bugs, edge cases, missing tests
